enum.name: RequestKind
enum.comment: What an NPC's request on the request board asks for.
enum.value: Something a shop sold out of, to put back on its shelf 0
Goods only one far-off shop sells 1
What a monster nobody has hunted lately drops, for more 3
Something only a shop's crafting makes 4
What rain brings out, open while it rains 5
What night brings out, open until dawn 6

enum.name: RequestHold
enum.comment: Who holds a request, as the player it's sent to sees it.
enum.value: Nobody: anyone can take it, or hand in to it 0
Someone in the player's party holds it, so the player can hand in to it too 2
Someone else holds it: another player, or one of the world's residents 3

struct.name: RequestEntry
struct.comment: A request on the request board, with what a client needs to show it: who asked, what for, what it pays, and who holds it.

field.name: gold
field.comment: The gold the whole request pays: now, or for a held request, what it paid when it was taken

field.name: rising
field.comment: Whether that gold is still rising while nobody takes it

field.name: gift_item_id
field.comment: What the NPC gives whoever finishes it; 0 for nothing

field.name: standing
field.comment: Whether finishing it earns standing with the NPC's town

field.name: shop
field.comment: Whether it's handed in by selling to the NPC's shop, rather than in a dialog with the NPC

field.name: monster_id
field.comment: The monster that drops what's wanted; 0 for none

field.name: minutes_left
field.comment: Minutes until it closes; 0 for a Rain or Night request

field.name: hold_minutes_left
field.comment: Minutes until whoever holds it runs out of time; 0 for an open request

field.name: far
field.comment: Whether it comes from another board's region, so there's further to go to hand it in

field.name: note
field.comment: What the NPC says about it

packet.comment: The server's time of day, for a day-night cycle: seconds since midnight on the server's clock. Sent on entering the game.
The weather over the world. Sent on entering the game, and to every player in the game whenever it changes.

The requests a request board lists for the player: those they hold first, then those nobody holds from the board's region, easiest first, then a few far ones, then every request anyone else holds, wherever it's from. Sent on opening the board, just before Board_Open, which lists the same requests as posts for clients without the extension, and again when the player takes or gives up a request there.
holders gives the name of whoever holds each request, in the same order, or an empty string for an open one. It and the fields after it come after the requests, so a client that stops reading there still works.

field.name: max_held
field.comment: How many requests a player may hold at once

field.name: wait_minutes
field.comment: Minutes until the player may take a request again, after giving one up or running out of time; 0 if they may now
